description: Gemini decan 3 (June 11 to June 20): personality, love, work and growth, with Uranus as sub-ruler of the third ten degrees of Gemini.
answer: In Western astrology, the third decan of Gemini covers 20° to 29° of the sign, roughly June 11 to June 20, with Uranus as its sub-ruler beside Mercury. It is read as inventive, independent thinking that leaps ahead of its time. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Gemini decan 3 personality
paragraphs: The final ten degrees of Gemini are Uranus's decan under the modern system, the planet associated with Aquarius. That influence gives the Twins' restless mind an inventive, sometimes rebellious streak. Third-decan Geminis are often described as original thinkers who connect ideas no one else thought to put together. They tend to question conventions out of genuine curiosity rather than defiance, though the effect can look similar. Technology, social causes and future-facing ideas often fascinate them. Conversation with them can jump across many fields in minutes and somehow land somewhere unexpected and useful. They are frequently the friend who sends the odd article that turns out to matter a month later.

Uranus brings independence, which can make this decan less socially accommodating than the Venus-touched middle stretch. They value freedom of thought and may resist being told what to think, even by people they love. Their friendships are often wide and varied, linked by shared interests rather than routine. The shadow side is detachment: they may intellectualise emotions or change direction abruptly when bored. Traditional decan lists predate Uranus, so modern astrologers emphasise its themes of innovation, community and surprise. Lived well, this blend produces a genuinely forward-looking mind that helps others imagine new possibilities. Their best insights often arrive sideways, halfway through a conversation about something else.

sections.heading: Gemini decan 3 in love and at work
paragraphs: Third-decan Geminis usually need a relationship that feels like a friendship first. Intellectual respect and personal freedom are non-negotiable; possessiveness tends to send them running. They are often drawn to unconventional partners or arrangements that suit both people's independence. Surprises and novelty keep them engaged. Emotional intimacy can take time, since they sometimes analyse feelings rather than express them. A partner who shares their curiosity, gives them space and also invites them gently into vulnerability tends to build a lasting bond with this decan.

At work, this decan often thrives in innovative or experimental fields. Technology, science communication, research and development, activism, design thinking, broadcasting and start-ups all suit their inventive streak. They tend to spot new solutions and dislike rigid hierarchies. Routine work or heavy bureaucracy can sap their energy quickly. Their contributions are often most valued in early, exploratory phases. Partnering with steadier colleagues for implementation helps ideas become reality. Learning to present unusual proposals in familiar language can also help their innovations gain support.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Gemini decan 3: what Uranus adds
paragraphs: The third decan covers 20° to 29° of Gemini, which in most years means birthdays from June 11 to June 20. Its sub-ruler, Uranus, comes from Aquarius, the last air sign after Gemini, so this decan borrows a little of Aquarius's character while staying Gemini at heart. The other two decans of Gemini belong to Mercury (decan 1) and Venus (decan 2). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Uranus brings originality, independence and a taste for the unconventional. Its decans tend to be described as more inventive and contrarian, quick to question tradition, attached to freedom and comfortable standing slightly apart from the crowd. Uranian decans are often linked with technology, reform, science and unusual lifestyles, and their usual lesson is to stay connected while staying free. Set against Gemini's curiosity, wit, adaptability and a quick, talkative mind, that Uranus note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Gemini decan 3
paragraphs: For third-decan Geminis, growth frequently involves balancing independence with connection. Try staying with an emotional conversation a little longer than feels comfortable before moving to analysis. Notice when the urge to change direction is genuine insight and when it is simply escape from difficulty. Committing to a community or cause over time can ground restless ideals. Simple routines, such as regular sleep and meals, can steady an excitable nervous system. Originality is valuable, and it gains power when it has roots as well as wings.

Within Gemini, decan 1 leans towards quicksilver curiosity, doubled and darting in every direction and decan 2 leans towards airy wit softened by venusian charm and social grace. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Which planet co-rules the third decan of Gemini?
faq.answer: Using modern rulerships, Uranus, the planet associated with Aquarius, is the sub-ruler of Gemini's closing degrees. It is read as adding originality, independence and an interest in innovation, so these Geminis are often described as inventive, future-minded thinkers who value intellectual freedom.

faq.question: What are the dates of Gemini decan 3?
faq.answer: In most years June 11 to June 20, the days when the Sun is between 20° and 29° of Gemini. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Gemini decan 3?
faq.answer: Uranus. In the triplicity system each air sign's decans take the rulers of the air signs in order, starting with Gemini's own ruler, Mercury.
